title: 環境土木設計演習
subtitle: Design/Exercises in Civil and Environmental Engineering
keywords: Civil Engineering around urban area 2.Environmental planning 3.Landscape Planning 4.Life line
educationalGoal: Students understand problem around urban area, and make basic design for them. Learn research methods based on basic knowledge of landscape engineering and landscape ecology in order to discuss urban infrastructure based on the local context. Learn the process of analyzing and discussing the subject by integrating related fields for regional planning and planning and design of urban infrastructure toward sustainable city.
advice: This course will impart a solid grounding in Soil Mechanics. The contents are shown as followings. 1. Importance and problem of urban area construction 2. Field survey and analysis. 3. Regional Design. 4. Propose improvement method under given conditions. 5. Presentation with drawings and models

 CLIP学習プロセスについて
 一般に、授業あるいは課外での学習では:「知識などを取り込む」→「知識などをいろいろな角度から、場合によってはチーム活動として、考え、推論し、創造する」→「修得した内容を表現、発表、伝達する」→「総合的に評価を受ける、GoodWork!」:のようなプロセス(一部あるいは全体)を繰り返し行いながら、応用力のある知識やスキルを身につけていくことが重要です。このような学習プロセスを大事に行動してください。
